name: MBTA
author: Christopher Garay
description: Live MBTA arrival times for your stations in the Omarchy bar — subway, Silver Line, bus, commuter rail, and ferry countdowns with a departure-board panel and station picker (search by name or scan around any address).

barWidget.description: Next train at your stops with live MBTA predictions; click for the full departure board and station picker.

schema.label: Stops (comma-separated MBTA stop IDs)
schema.description: Stations shown on the board. Easiest edited through the panel's Manage Stations picker; each id is an MBTA stop like place-dwnxg or place-north.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often live predictions are fetched from api-v3.mbta.com. Countdown labels re-render every few seconds between fetches without new requests.

schema.label: Departures per line/direction row
schema.description: Countdown chips kept per route+direction grouping on the panel.

schema.label: Fall back to schedules when there are no predictions
schema.description: Late night, when real-time data goes quiet, show scheduled departures instead of an empty board.

schema.label: Pinned arrival row
schema.description: Internal station and route selection used for the bar countdown. Set or clear it with the Pin control in the arrivals panel.

schema.label: Station picker mode
schema.description: Internal preference for resuming the station picker by name or nearby location.

schema.label: Your location
schema.description: Your saved address, place, or coordinates for finding nearby stations.

schema.label: Last nearby radius (km)
schema.description: Search radius last used by the nearby station picker.
